dict.string: PasDisk measures how much disk space each folder on your Mac uses. Access to your music library lets PasDisk include it in your storage breakdown - for example, showing that your Music library takes up 15 GB so you can decide what to clean up. OpenDisk only reads file names and sizes; it never plays, uploads, or modifies your music.

PasDisk measures how much disk space each folder uses. Access to network volumes lets PasDisk scan drives you connect over the network - for example, showing that a NAS share holds 500 GB of backups. OpenDisk only reads file names and sizes; it never uploads or modifies your files.

PasDisk measures how much disk space each folder uses. Access to removable volumes lets PasDisk scan external drives and USB disks you plug in - for example, showing that an external drive holds 200 GB of old projects.
